title: Panic Attacks: Symptoms, Causes, Panic vs Heart Attack and What to Do
seoTitle: Panic Attack Symptoms, Causes and What to Do
seoDescription: Panic attack symptoms peak within minutes and usually pass in 5–20 minutes. Learn the causes, how it differs from a heart attack and help in India.
excerpt: A side-by-side guide to panic attack versus heart attack warning signs, the medical conditions doctors rule out, breathing steps from the NHS, how to help someone mid-attack, and free help in India through Tele MANAS.
